Bek Lover returns to Danny Jones for a talk on the end times in three faiths. The episode title names Christianity, Islam, and the poor man's nuke. Lover reads world events through Bible prophecy and street sense.

Lover lays out how he thinks the last days will unfold and who will strike first. He links scripture to war, terror, and the fear of a cheap bomb in the wrong hands. Jones lets him preach, then tests the claims with news of the day. Listeners get a raw take on prophecy and fear. The library holds the episode as an archive record of the guest's beliefs.
